reasons.text: The label photo is legible and shows model A17B0, which is a recalled model, so the model is confirmed.
The claimed purchase date of 2022-11-20 is before the program's sale window (2023-05-01 to 2023-09-30), so the purchase is outside the eligible sales period.
The retailer, TD Synnex, is on the program's list, so the retailer alone does not disqualify the claim; the date is the deciding factor.
No duplicate claims were found sharing a photo, address, email, serial, or payout account.
